methods.name: LowerBound
methods.signature: method LowerBound(s: seq<int>, key: int) returns (p: int)
methods.header:
method LowerBound(s: seq<int>, key: int) returns (p: int)
  requires forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < |s| ==> s[i] <= s[j]
  ensures 0 <= p <= |s|
  ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < p ==> s[i] < key
  ensures forall i :: p <= i < |s| ==> s[i] >= key

mutants.violation: Fails a fixed postcondition for a permitted input.

representations.natural: [R1] The sequence s is nondecreasing: for all valid indices i < j, s[i] is at most s[j]. [R2] The result p is between zero and the length of s, inclusive. [R3] Every element before index p is strictly less than key. [R4] Every element at or after index p is at least key.
